location_description:
North Brookfield is a town in Worcester County, Massachusetts, United States. The population was 4,735 at the 2020 census.For geographic and demographic information on the census-designated place North Brookfield, please see the article North Brookfield (CDP), Massachusetts.


== History ==
North Brookfield was first settled in 1664 and was officially incorporated in 1812, splitting from neighboring Brookfield.
